lenses.sp: Wants a large, steady, cheap company with a strong balance sheet.
lenses.vd: In Benjamin Graham's spirit: a great business, but this lens's own price test fails and the price is 465% above the fair value of ₹554.

ch.r: Market value above ₹5,000 crore
ch.w: Graham avoided small companies; ₹5,000 crore is our Indian translation of 'adequate size'.

ch.r: Current assets ÷ current liabilities ≥ 2
ch.w: For every ₹100 it owes within a year, it holds ₹138 of cash, stock and dues coming in.

ch.r: Long-term debt ≤ current assets − current liabilities
ch.v: Long-term debt ₹30 cr vs working capital ₹115 cr
ch.w: Graham wanted the short-term cushion alone to be able to repay long-term loans.

ch.n: A profit every year for 10 years
ch.r: Positive earnings in each of the last 10 years
ch.v: Profit in all 4 yrs we have
ch.w: No loss in the years we can see; the earlier years are not in the free data.

ch.r: Dividends every year for 20 years (India: 10 years)
ch.w: NSE corporate actions not fetched.

ch.n: Earnings per share up a third in 10 years
ch.r: EPS +33% over 10 years (3-year averages at each end)
ch.w: EPS (average of the first 2 vs last 2 years we have) moved +945%.

ch.r: PE ≤ 15 on 3-year average earnings
ch.w: You pay ₹265 for every ₹1 of average yearly profit over the last 3 yrs.
You pay ₹26.47 for every ₹1 of net worth.

ch.r: Price < √(22.5 × EPS × book value per share)
ch.w: With EPS ₹29.2 and book value ₹118 per share, Graham's ceiling price is ₹279.

🟡 Profit jumped 5.0× – valued on normal years (profit jumped 15.1× while sales grew 2.4× (₹129 cr vs a normal ₹9 cr)); new level confirmed: 2 quarters reported since the spike year (FY ending 2026-03-31); 2 reached the new level (₹21 cr a quarter = 80% of ₹104 cr ÷ 4)

v4.ll: Passes Fisher, F-score-style checks; great business but price not right for Graham, Munger, Agrawal; fails Greenblatt, Kedia-style checks
ch: Drops to Hold if the quality score falls below 70 (now 83); to Avoid below 50.

Buy zone: below ₹295 (25% under the absolute value ₹393, 🛡️ Strict view), if the view's own conditions hold, confidence is Medium or High and the trend is up. Accumulate zone: ₹471–₹637 (consensus ₹554).
Moves to Trim above ₹720 (30% over fair value).

Any new serious red flag (auditor resigns mid-term, pledge above 25%, SEBI order, negative net worth, weak cash conversion together with high accruals, distress with interest cover below 1.5×) moves it straight to Avoid.
